title: Direct Vertex-Derivative Coefficient Propagation forHomogeneous Numerical Integration (HNI)
summary: Homogeneous numerical integration (HNI) combines Euler's identity and Stokes' theorem to integrate homogeneous polynomials over a polytope $P$. Existing algorithms return scalar integrals or reusable moment families. Any resulting moment table can be recoded afterward: once all degree-$q$ moments are known, integration on $\mathcal H\_q$ (degree-$q$ forms) has a trivial representation by a pure order-$q$ distribution supported at any single arbitrary point.
